author: hattrill
body: * **PTHR ID & PTN node:** PTN000336667 PTN000336666 30S RIBOSOMAL PROTEIN S18 (PTHR13479) * **Sequences with problematic annotation (ID + gene/protein name):** * mRpS18A FBgn0051450 mitochondrial small ribosomal subunit small ribosomal subunit rRNA binding * **Type of Issue: Erroneous source or erroneous propagation, or other issue** Think this might involve some spitting of the Panther group in metazoans. From: PMID:27489352 and structural info: In the metazoan lineage there are three one S18 genes. Fungi, Viridiplantae and Protists only have one S18 gene. In bacteria, the S18 subunit is located in the small ribosomal subunit. This is conserved in other lineages and is equivalent to the metazoan MRPS18C subunit. MRPS18B is also located in the small subunit, but at a different site and while MRPS18A is a component of the large subunit. human MRPS18A UniProtKB:Q9NVS2 has an IDA to mitochondrial large ribosomal subunit which could be used in propagation. I have disputed the small subunit annotation as it is an error.
title: PAINT issue:PTN000336667PANTHER, PTN000336666 30S RIBOSOMAL PROTEIN S18 (PTHR13479)
